thesis: The episode introduces Meredith Jenkins, the chief investment officer of Trinity Wall Street, and outlines her career path from investment banking at Goldman Sachs and research at Sanford Bernstein to her current role overseeing the church's endowment. The conversation begins by exploring her early lessons regarding the skepticism faced during IPO roadshows and the contrast between the difficult life of an analyst and the perceived good lives of the managers they cover.
